name: Pleat
author: E. T. Carter
description: Crisp accordion-pleated fabric folds the frame into flat-shaded panels divided by hard crease lines, while a broad band of light rolls horizontally across the cloth and the creases bow and lean on slow sines.

params.label: Pleat width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of one accordion panel; narrow makes a fine ribbed texture, wide makes bold architectural folds.

params.label: Roll speed
params.effect: How fast the illumination band travels across the pleats; at 0 the light rests while only the cloth sways.

params.label: Sway
params.effect: Amplitude of crease bowing and leaning, from rigid pressed pleats to softly breathing fabric.
